snippet.title: GORAG - Physics Sandbox | Launch Trailer (Android/iOS)
snippet.description:
Mobile Game Name: GORAG - Physics Sandbox
AppStore: bit.ly/3J603JX 
Play Market: https://bit.ly/3Ull0D2

PC Game Name: Ragdore
Steam: bit.ly/3Uiw6J5

GORAG is a single-player physics sandbox built for pure experimentation and creative destruction. This is not a game about winning — it's a playful physics playground where the goal is to explore, break, and mess with everything.

GORAG is a physics sandbox made for experimentation: launch your character off ramps, bounce them off trampolines, throw them into contraptions, or test how far things can fall apart. Every move is powered by physics — no fake animations, just raw reactions and unexpected results.

GORAG includes 3 unique sandbox maps at launch:

Ragdoll Park – a colorful playground with giant slides and soft shapes, ideal for testing movement and silly experiments

Crazy Mountain – an experimental fall map focused on momentum, collisions, and chaos

Polygon Map – an industrial sandbox playground filled with interactive elements: trampolines, rotating machines, barrels, moving parts, and environmental triggers designed for all kinds of physics experiments

There’s no story, no objectives — just a physics sandbox built for destruction, testing, and endless playground fun. Jump, crawl, crash, or fly: every outcome depends on how you use the sandbox.

Features:

A fully interactive physics sandbox with no limits
Playful destruction tools and reactive environments
A simulated character that moves based on what's left of their body
A dummy NPC for testing wild physics experiments
Stylized visuals built around readable, satisfying reactions
A chaotic playground to explore, test, and break things
Tools, trampolines and hazards designed for sandbox-based experimentation

Whether you're building a chain reaction or triggering total chaos, RAGDORE offers a sandbox playground where physics is everything, and destruction is just part of the fun.
